title: Itemized Statement Service Standards, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Itemized statements on a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) are issued free of charge, through the patient's choice of U.S. mail, the patient portal or an email link, within a turnaround that depends on the patient class; a request also pauses collection activity for a set number of calendar days.

## Standards

- **Turnaround**: business days (Monday through Friday, excluding Riverbend holidays) after the request within which the itemized statement is issued.
- **Collection pause**: calendar days that collection activity (statements past the current cycle, the final notice and placement) pauses after an itemized statement is requested.
- **Fee**: 0.00 USD for every patient class; Riverbend provides itemized statements free.
- **Delivery channels**: U.S. mail, patient portal and email link, for every patient class.

| Patient class | Turnaround (business days) | Collection pause (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | 5 | 30 |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | 5 | 30 |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 7 | 30 |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 5 | 30 |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | 7 | 30 |
| Observation Stay Account | 7 | 45 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 10 | 45 |

## Illustration (hypothetical request)

A request logged on a Monday for an Inpatient Admission Account, with no Riverbend holiday in the following two weeks, is due within 10 business days, that is by the Monday two weeks later; collection activity beyond the current cycle pauses for 45 calendar days from the request.
